title: Account Coordinator -3PL / Ecommerce
description:
Account Coordinator -3 PL / Ecommerce
Location: Mansfield
Salary: 28,000 - 32,000 DOE
Full Time, Permanent

TurnerFox Recruitment are currently recruiting for several 3 PL / Ecommerce Account Coordinators to join growing businesses within the Mansfield area.

We are keen to hear from candidates who have previous experience within 3 PL, ecommerce, fulfilment, logistics or distribution environments and enjoy working in a customer-focused role.

- Comfortable working within a fast-paced operational environment
- A team player with a flexible and hands-on approach

title: Brand and Marketing Manager
description:
Brand and Marketing Manager
Newark, Nottinghamshire - Full Time - Salary up to £50,000
SF Partners are partnering with an established business to recruit a Brand and Marketing Manager.
With a portfolio of innovative in-house brands and exclusive distribution partnerships, this entrepreneurial business is looking for an ambitious, commercially minded marketer to help drive its next stage of growth.
The role
Working alongside an established in-house design team, you'll shape brand positioning, identify opportunities and develop campaigns that build awareness and drive sales. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, giving you the opportunity to influence a diverse portfolio of brands.
Key responsibilities
- Develop and deliver marketing plans across multiple brands and product categories.
- Create clear, inspiring creative briefs for the in-house design team.
- Lead product launches and integrated marketing campaigns.
- Manage trade marketing, PR and media relationships.
- Work closely with brand partners and suppliers to maximise marketing opportunities.
- Plan and deliver exhibitions and events.
- Identify opportunities to grow brand awareness, customer engagement and sales.
- Monitor campaign performance and use insights to improve results.

About you
- Proven marketing experience with a strong track record of building brands and delivering campaigns.
- Excellent communication skills, including the ability to turn ideas into effective creative briefs.
- A balance of commercial awareness and creative thinking.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
- A proactive, hands-on approach and the confidence to bring new ideas to life.

The opportunity
You'll help shape the future of a varied brand portfolio, working alongside a talented creative team in a business where ideas can quickly become reality. This is an opportunity to take ownership, influence brand direction and make a measurable contribution to growth.
To find out more or apply, contact SF Partners.

title: Communcation & Engagement Manager
description:
Communications & Engagement Manager

Location: Nottingham
Working arrangement: On-site

SF Recruitment are exclusively working with an established organisation in Nottingham to recruit a Communications & Engagement Manager to join their People team.

This is a varied role combining internal and external communications, employee engagement, organisational culture and inclusion. We're looking for someone who can take ownership of the communications and engagement strategy, while also being hands-on in delivering initiatives that make a genuine difference across the business.

Working closely with the Head of HR and wider leadership team, you'll play an important role in improving how the organisation communicates with its employees, engages with stakeholders and creates an inclusive working environment.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Developing and delivering internal and external communications and employee engagement strategies
- Creating communications plans, campaigns and engaging content for different audiences
- Managing internal communication channels, including newsletters, intranet updates, employee briefings and business announcements
- Supporting senior leaders with clear and consistent communications across the organisation
- Developing employee engagement initiatives, surveys, focus groups and feedback opportunities
- Analysing employee feedback and engagement data to identify trends and recommend improvements
- Supporting equality, diversity and inclusion initiatives and helping embed inclusive practices across the business
- Planning and coordinating employee events, recognition activities and engagement campaigns
- Managing external communications, media relationships and PR agency activity
- Building relationships with internal and external stakeholders
- Supporting communications around organisational change, sensitive matters and business developments
- Monitoring the effectiveness of communications and engagement initiatives and producing reports and recommendations

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone with previous experience in communications, employee engagement or a similar role, ideally gained within a medium to large organisation.

You'll need:
- Experience developing and delivering internal and external communications strategies
- Strong written communication skills and the ability to create engaging content for different audiences
- Experience delivering employee engagement initiatives and gathering meaningful feedback
- A good understanding of organisational culture, equality, diversity and inclusion
- Confidence working with senior stakeholders and influencing people across different levels of a business
- Experience managing communications campaigns and multiple projects simultaneously
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise effectively
- An analytical approach, with experience using engagement data and feedback to drive improvements
- The ability to handle sensitive information and challenging conversations professionally
- A relevant qualification in Communications, Marketing, HR, Business or equivalent professional experience

You'll be someone who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery. We're particularly interested in someone who is proactive, confident building relationships and comfortable taking ownership of projects from initial planning through to implementation.

This role would suit an experienced Communications or Employee Engagement professional who enjoys working closely with people, improving organisational culture and making sure employees feel informed, involved and listened to.

If this sounds like something you'd be interested in exploring, please get in touch with your updated CV.

title: Communications engagement and Inclusion Manager
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Communications, Engagement & Inclusion Manager

Nottingham Up to £45,000 Permanent Hybrid - 4 Days Onsite

Macildowie are working with this client based in Nottingham to recruit a Communications, Engagement & Inclusion Manager for an established organisation operating within the transport and infrastructure sector.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a creative communications professional who is passionate about bringing people together, improving employee engagement and making a genuine difference to workplace culture.

Working closely with the People team, you'll take ownership of internal communications, employee engagement initiatives and inclusion activities, helping to create an environment where employees feel informed, connected and valued.

The Role

You'll be responsible for developing engaging communications and delivering initiatives that strengthen employee experience across a busy, operational organisation.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Creating compelling internal communications, newsletters, presentations and employee updates.
- Developing visually engaging content using Canva, Adobe or similar creative tools.
- Managing internal communications channels, including the company intranet.
- Designing and delivering employee engagement campaigns, events and recognition initiatives.
- Supporting equality, diversity and inclusion initiatives to encourage belonging and a positive workplace culture.
- Working with managers and senior stakeholders to communicate key business messages effectively.
- Supporting employer branding and social media content to showcase the organisation as an employer of choice.
- Gathering employee feedback and using insights to improve engagement and communication effectiveness.

About You

We're looking for someone who combines strong communication skills with creativity, initiative and the confidence to work independently.

You'll ideally bring:
- Proven experience in internal communications, employee engagement or a closely related role.
- Excellent written communication skills and the ability to tailor content to different audiences.
- Creative flair and experience producing professional, visually engaging materials.
- Confidence using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar design platforms.
- Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
- The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- A proactive, resilient and adaptable approach.
- A genuine interest in employee experience, organisational culture and inclusion.

Experience within a People or HR function, an operational environment or a unionised organisation would be advantageous, although not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary up to £45,000.
- Permanent opportunity within an established organisation.
- Hybrid working arrangement, with four days onsite and one day working from home, subject to business needs.
- 40-hour working week, including paid breaks.
- Flexible start and finish times.
- The opportunity to take ownership of communications and engagement initiatives.
- A varied role where your ideas, creativity and contribution can have a visible impact.

Interested?

If you're a creative communications professional who enjoys connecting with people and making a meaningful difference to employee experience, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Junior AI & Digital Marketing Executive
description:
The company is a growing marketing consultancy supporting clients across the East Midlands and throughout the UK. It delivers innovative marketing solutions designed to increase visibility, generate leads, and improve business performance through a blend of digital marketing, content strategy and emerging technologies.

As the digital landscape continues to evolve, the company is investing heavily in Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and data-driven marketing approaches. It is seeking a motivated Junior AI & Digital Marketing Executive to support client campaigns and help shape the future of AI-powered search marketing.

This role presents an excellent opportunity for an ambitious individual seeking to develop a career in modern digital marketing, regardless of whether they have significant prior industry experience.

The Role

The Junior AI & Digital Marketing Executive will support the planning, delivery, and optimisation of digital marketing campaigns for a diverse client portfolio.

The successful candidate will gain hands-on experience across a broad range of marketing disciplines, including Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), content marketing, social media management, email marketing, analytics, and the application of AI tools within marketing workflows.

Training and development will be provided to enable the successful candidate to build specialist expertise in this rapidly evolving area.

Key Responsibilities

Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)
- Research and monitor how clients are represented across AI-powered search and answer platforms, including ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.
- Assist in creating and optimising content designed to answer customer questions effectively.
- Support the development of FAQs, knowledge centres, and topic authority content.
- Assist with structured content creation and schema implementation.
- Conduct keyword, topic and search intent research.
- Identify opportunities to improve clients' visibility across search engines and AI-powered platforms.

Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies
- Utilise AI tools to support content creation, research, campaign planning and ideation.
- Develop effective prompts and workflows to increase marketing efficiency.
- Evaluate new AI technologies and identify opportunities for client application.
- Support the implementation of AI-assisted marketing processes.
- Ensure AI-generated content meets quality, accuracy and brand standards.

Digital Marketing
- Create engaging website content, blogs, case studies and marketing collateral.
- Support social media planning, content creation and scheduling.
- Assist with email marketing campaigns and customer communications.
- Contribute to SEO activities aimed at increasing organic visibility.
- Support website updates and content management tasks.
- Undertake competitor and market research projects.
- Assist in delivering integrated digital marketing campaigns.

Skills & Experience
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational ability.
- Interest in digital marketing, AI and emerging technologies.
- Confidence working with online platforms and digital tools.
- A proactive approach to learning and problem solving.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

title: Marketing and Campaigns Coordinator
description:
Great ideas deserve to be brought to life. Could you be the person to make that happen?

£28,000 FTE £12,800 actual salary 16 hours per week Hybrid working Mansfield

We can offer

Flexible part-time hours: 16 hours per week, with the working pattern agreed to suit both you and the business.

Hybrid working: A minimum of 50% of your working hours based at our Mansfield office.

Real involvement: The opportunity to take responsibility for campaigns and see the results of your work.

Support and collaboration: Direct access to the people making business decisions, with opportunities to contribute your own ideas.

Variety: A role that combines creative work, research, planning and practical delivery.

Do you enjoy turning ideas into engaging content? Are you someone who takes pride in the details, likes having a clear plan and gets satisfaction from seeing your work make a difference?

Perhaps you've worked in marketing for a few years and are now looking for a role that offers greater flexibility without losing the opportunity to use your skills, contribute ideas and take ownership of your work.

What makes this opportunity different?

We're not looking for someone to arrive with a completely new marketing strategy or reinvent our business, we already know who our customers are, understand the challenges they face and have developed ideas for campaigns we want to deliver. We need someone who enjoys the practical side of marketing. Someone who can take an idea, think about the best way to communicate it, create the materials, organise the activity and see it through to completion.

You'll have the freedom to be creative, the support of an experienced team and the satisfaction of seeing the results of your work.

What will you be doing?
- Bringing campaigns to life: Turning our marketing ideas into engaging, well-planned campaigns that reach the right businesses.
- Creating great content: Producing LinkedIn posts, graphics, email campaigns, newsletters, brochures and other promotional materials.
- Finding the right audience: Researching prospective customers and understanding the businesses and people we want to engage with.
- Keeping everything organised: Maintaining a marketing calendar, coordinating activities and ensuring campaigns happen when planned.
- Making our message stand out: Finding interesting, clear and professional ways to explain how LivePay helps businesses.
- Seeing what works: Monitoring engagement and campaign results, identifying improvements and sharing your findings.
- Contributing your ideas: Working with our Customer Development Manager and Managing Director to develop and improve our marketing activities.

What experience would help?

Ideally, you'll have some practical experience in marketing, communications, content creation or a similar role. We're looking for someone who brings creativity, enthusiasm and organisation, takes pride in their work and is comfortable taking ownership of tasks, asking questions and listening to feedback.

We'd particularly welcome experience in:
- Creating professional, engaging written content.
- Managing LinkedIn or other business social media campaigns.
- Using Canva or similar design tools.
- Producing email marketing campaigns and promotional materials.
- Researching prospective customers or target audiences.
- Organising marketing activities and managing deadlines.
- Using CRM systems, website tools or marketing analytics.

Experience of business-to-business marketing would be helpful, but it's not essential. You don't need to be an expert in payroll. We'll help you understand our services and our customers.

We're more interested in what you can do, how you approach your work and the pride you take in delivering it than in a long list of qualifications.

A little about us

At LivePay, we've been helping businesses manage their payroll for over 45 years. We're an independent, family-run business with a straightforward approach: combine great technology with knowledgeable, friendly people who genuinely care about the customers they support. We have plenty of experience, lots of knowledge to share and some exciting ideas about how we can reach more businesses.

What we don't have is enough time to bring all those ideas to life. That's where you come in.

Interested? We'd love to see what you can do.

We'd love to hear about your experience and see examples of marketing materials, campaigns or content you've helped create.

Apply with your CV and a short introduction explaining why this role interests you.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
A Bank on a Mission

Since new ownership in 2020, Kingdom Bank has been rapidly growing. Churches and Christians across the UK are increasingly looking to us because they want their savings to fuel gospel mission and not just sit in a standard high-street account. We're becoming the go-to bank for evangelical churches, Christians and Christian-led businesses, and we're just getting started!

Are You Our New Marketing Executive?

Good with words? Do some good with them.

Are you a creative marketer with a talent for writing content and delivering distinctive campaigns? Would you like to use your skills to help churches grow and support gospel mission across the UK?

Kingdom Bank is looking for a Marketing Executive to join our team. This is a hands-on role focused on delivering marketing activity across campaigns, content, customer communications and digital channels.

Working closely with the Brand and Campaigns Manager, you will create engaging website, email and social media content, support marketing campaigns, develop customer communications and help share the stories that demonstrate the impact of Kingdom Bank's work. You will also work with colleagues across the Bank and external agencies to deliver marketing activity that supports customer acquisition, engagement and growth.

We're looking for a strong communicator with excellent copywriting skills, experience in a marketing or communications role, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy and attention to detail.

This role would suit someone who is proactive, organised and passionate about driving results.

Give your marketing career a mission.

Occupational Requirement: Kingdom Bank has an occupational requirement under the Equality Act 2010 for the post-holder to be a committed Christian who can actively support and contribute to the Bank's Christian mission, values and culture.

A Small Team With Big Impact

We're a close-knit team of around 60 people - small enough that every individual can shape the Bank's direction. Our culture is hardworking, warm, informal, and passionate about making Jesus known. We trust our people to balance flexibility with responsibility, support one another, and deliver excellent service for our customers. And we invest in our team through training, development, and opportunities to grow and progress.

ROLE

The Marketing Executive plays a key role in delivering Kingdom Bank's marketing activity, providing hands-on support across campaigns, content, customer communications and digital channels. The role combines broad marketing expertise with a particular strength in writing, communication and content creation, enabling the successful execution of marketing plans whilst upholding the Bank's three priorities of Quality, Culture and Growth.

When you'll work

35 hours per week, generally expected to be worked Mondays to Fridays and between 8.30am and 5.30pm. However part-time hours are a consideration in this role. The working pattern will be agreed with the line manager under the Bank's flexible working policy.

27 days (or pro-rata equivalent) paid holiday (excluding bank holidays), and the opportunity to purchase additional holiday up to a maximum entitlement of 32 days per annum.

Where you'll work

The ideal candidate would be able to attend the Bank's office at least once a week, but with a minimum expectation of at least two office-based days per month in accordance with the Bank's flexible working policy.

The Bank's office is located at Media House, Padge Road, Beeston, Nottingham, NG9 2 RS, and remote workers are responsible for covering commuting and accommodation costs when attending the office.

Salary & Benefits

Salary, dependent on skills and experience, between £30,000 and £35,000 with a pro-rata equivalent for a part-time role.

Salary sacrifice pension scheme: 9% of salary (up to £50,000) on an unmatched basis and up to 4% of total salary on a matched basis.

Other benefits in accordance with the Bank's People Policy on completion of probation, including travel loan scheme, electric vehicle salary sacrifice leasing scheme, enhanced maternity pay, payroll giving scheme, additional holiday purchase, private medical insurance, free eye tests, and death in service benefit.

Probation

The post is subject to a three months' probation period.

Closing Date

Sunday 29 November

Interview Date

Mid December

If you believe that you have the skills and the passion to join the Kingdom Bank team, please download the application pack and complete the application form for this role on our website

title: Native German Speaking Content Marketing Executive

- Create, review, and optimise content for German-speaking audiences, ensuring accuracy and relevance
- Creating new product lines and enhancing the digital shelf through text and image optimisation
- Identifying and resolving product setup issues

- Fluent in German, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Curious and proactive, willing to ask questions to understand challenges and solve problems

As a Certified B Corporation, we are part of a global community committed to high standards of social and environmental performance.

How to Apply

If this role interests you, please attach your CV via the link provided.

To ensure your application is reviewed, include the phrase "I am able to work 2 days a week in Southwell"-preferably in the subject line.

MinsterFB values diversity and is committed to an inclusive recruitment process. We welcome applicants from underrepresented groups and encourage you to bring your whole self to work. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: PPC Executive - German Speaking
description:
Are you a recent German speaking Marketing graduate looking for your first role?

Or

Do you have existing PPC experience?

Are you looking for a fully remote and permanent role within the UK?

If so, APPLY NOW!

The Client:

An expanding and fast-moving Google Ads agency for D2 C brands across the UK and Europe. Most of their clients sell on Shopify. They don't just run the ads, they manage the whole system behind performance: data, structure, feeds and profit.

They are a fully remote, multilingual team, owning our accounts end to end. And they look after each other: flexible hours, unlimited leave, team retreats.

Google Partner. Shopify Partner. ProfitMetrics partner.

The Role:

You'll own a portfolio of eCommerce accounts across European markets, with DACH at the centre. You'll know each client's margins, their hero products and what needs doing next.

More Detail:
- Run and grow Shopping, Performance Max and Demand Gen for DTC brands
- Set structure and governance across Performance Max and Demand Gen, and hold it
- Write and maintain scripts that catch problems early and save hours
- Find feed issues and disapprovals, and fix them
- Lead client calls in German and English, with the numbers and a clear plan
- Bid towards profit, not just revenue, where the account supports it

Experience Required:

You can be a recent marketing graduate looking for your first role or will have:
- Experience in Google Ads, with an eCommerce-first background
- Strong Google Shopping skills: Performance Max, Demand Gen governance, scripts
- Fluent German, written and spoken - essential
- Conversational English - essential
- Ownership. You hit the ground running and don't wait to be told

Added skills (Not essential):
- French or Spanish Speaking
- Multi-market European campaign experience
